authority: Planner task (pilot-ready Worker, 2026-11-23): PP1-PP8 as given; operational evaluation and derived numbers by the Worker

memory.caution: the 3-cycle RSS still grows (cycles 1-3); PP7 at 300 cycles rests on ruling 7's step 4 full-run figure (<= 3.53 GiB), not on this trajectory
memory.rule: ruling 7: 4.0 GiB per slot; block 1 requires 5 x 4.0 = 20 GiB available

derived_from_existing_data.note: numbers derived from committed records before the pilot (3-cycle and 2-cycle runs, unconverged); they inform the predictions and the launch plan, they are not predictions themselves

projection.definition: wall of one pilot run to K = 300 = 300 x mean s/cycle (cycles 1-3 of gate F) + the real check's child overhead (build, initialisation, terminal phase) [x the largest gate F per-candidate contention for the 5-way block]; the cycle time at tail depth (cycles >~ c* - 10) is UNMEASURED on EV and may be longer

real_check.label: real check: reference unit, 2x, stop-disabled + pricing, cap 3, concurrency 1

objective_convention: F = I(x) + gross_operational_cost - TV credit, EUR of total discounted planning cost (cost-breakdown schema v2); gross settlement-excluded

PP1.evaluated_as: per run: exit_code 0, evaluation_record.cycles_run == 300 == cap, evaluation_record.local_solve_failures == 0 and local_solves_ok True on every per-cycle row; c* = the first cycle with consecutive_converged_cycles >= required_consecutive_cycles (10) (driver would_be_certification_cycle / pilot_outputs c_star) exists and c* <= 200. Held iff all 7 hold.
PP1.on_failure: recorded with the failing runs named; a run without c* leaves pilot_outputs without e_EV (failure named) -- stop for the Planner before any search freeze
PP1.statement: all 7 runs reach 300 cycles with 0 local-solve failures; each has a would-be certification cycle <= 200

PP2.evaluated_as: per run: driver map_record(files, settled) status == "settled": cycles_run == K = 300; each of cycles 291-300 at tail depth (convergence_depth_tail_state.json per_cycle[k].active); cycle_convergence True on each of cycles 291-300; guards exact; no local-solve failure. Held iff all 7 are settled.
PP2.on_failure: recorded with the failed settled conditions named per run (not_settled_reasons); stop for the Planner
PP2.statement: every run is settled at K = 300 per the design (tail depth and would-have-certified on the last 10 cycles)

PP3.evaluated_as: per run: S = max - min of F over cycles 291-300, F = I(x) + gross_operational_cost - TV credit (EUR of total discounted planning cost; cost-breakdown schema v2), from the per-cycle record (driver f_series); held iff S <= 500.0 on all 7
PP3.on_failure: recorded; K_EV is then set by the ruling 2 rule from the pilot trace (it may be None: failure named, stop for the Planner)
PP3.statement: S <= 500 EUR at K = 300 on all 7

PP4.evaluated_as: pilot_outputs.max_pair_offset: the 15 pairs = 9 unit_i - x0_j (i, j in i1-i3), 3 staged - x0_j, 3 staged - unit_j; dF_exit at each run's would-be certification cycle, dF_set at K_EV (the frozen rule); the same quantity with dF_set at K = 300 is reported beside. Held iff <= 15,000.0
PP4.on_failure: recorded (margin prediction): stop for the Planner before e_EV is used
PP4.statement: the largest exit-vs-settled pair offset, |dF_exit - dF_set| over the 15 pairs, is <= 15,000 EUR

PP5.evaluated_as: pilot_outputs.dF_set_spread_3x3 = max - min of F_set(unit_i) - F_set(x0_j) over the 9 pairs, F_set at K_EV; the K = 300 value reported beside. Held iff <= 2,500.0
PP5.on_failure: recorded (margin prediction): stop for the Planner
PP5.statement: the dF_set spread of (unit - x0) across the 3 x 3 initialisation pairs is <= 2,500 EUR

PP6.evaluated_as: map_record(files, settled).leak.priced_loss_eur (conversion-loss price, TASKS 8f2a878a) at K = 300 on unit_i1, unit_i2, unit_i3 and staged_i1; held iff <= 25.0 on all four (x0 reported beside)
PP6.on_failure: to the Expert as the row-tolerance question (TASKS 28ba36b4 decision (i))
PP6.statement: the loss-priced leak at the settled point is <= 25 EUR on the unit and on the staged plan

PP7.evaluated_as: per run: evaluation_record.peak_rss.child_python_process_ru_maxrss / 2^30 (bytes on macOS); held iff <= 4.0 on all 7; the search spec then declares max x 1.15 (ruling 7)
PP7.on_failure: recorded; the search spec's per-slot figure is max x 1.15 by ruling 7 (a larger figure may reduce the search concurrency: Planner)

PP8.evaluated_as: (a) per run: mean over cycles 1-300 of production's "Iteration k: X s" wall, divided by the 1-way-equivalence factor of its block -- block 1 (5-way): the gate F ev_v1 shared-candidate contention kappa (B/A); block 2 (2-way): not deflated (an upper bound); held iff in [20, 35] for every run. (b) psi = pilot_outputs.psi = max over blocks of >= 2 runs of max t_exit / mean t_exit (ruling 4: block makespan / mean t_exit); held iff <= 1.3
PP8.on_failure: recorded; the wall-time projection uses the measured t_exit, t_set and psi
